title: Constant-coefficient algebraic inverse-image and derived-pullback data
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(C',J')$ be small sites, with their sheaf topoi [def-weil-pbc-topos]. Use the module-sheaf categories $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$, cochain categories $\operatorname{Cx}(R)$, standard localizations $Q_R:\operatorname{Cx}(R)\to D(R)$, ordinary scalar extension $\operatorname{change}_c$, and its pure tensor sections from [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data]; use the constant ring sheaves $\underline A$ of [def-pur-strict-quotient-completion-data]. Write $|M|$ for the underlying sheaf of sets of a module sheaf. For $c:R\to S$ define $\operatorname{insertion}_c(M):|M|\to|\operatorname{change}_c(M)|$ by $m\mapsto1\otimes m$, including sheafification. For a functor $L:\operatorname{Sh}(J)\to\operatorname{Sh}(J')$, define $\operatorname{InverseImageData}(L)$ to consist of a functor $F_{\mathrm{rings}}$ on commutative ring sheaves, an algebraic inverse-image lift [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image] for each $R$ from $R$ to $F_{\mathrm{rings}}R$, naturality of the underlying ring isomorphisms in ring-sheaf maps, and a natural isomorphism $\operatorname{constant}_J F_{\mathrm{rings}}\cong\operatorname{constant}_{J'}$. For such data $F$ and $c:F_{\mathrm{rings}}R\to S$, define $\operatorname{pull}_{F,c}$ to be the algebraic module inverse image followed by $\operatorname{change}_c$. Define $\operatorname{pullInsertion}_{F,c}(M):L|M|\to|\operatorname{pull}_{F,c}M|$ by the inverse of the algebraic underlying-module isomorphism followed by $\operatorname{insertion}_c$. Define $\operatorname{DerivedPull}(F,c)$ to be a functor $T:D(R)\to D(S)$ and a comparison $Q_RT\to\operatorname{pull}_{F,c}^{\operatorname{Cx}}Q_S$ exhibiting its left-derived universal property at quasi-isomorphisms, with invertible comparison on every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] whose terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. When $L$ is the inverse image of a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism], write $\operatorname{derivedPull}_{F,c}$ for the universally specified such pair, unique up to comparison-preserving natural isomorphism. Define $\operatorname{constantMap}_F(A):F_{\mathrm{rings}}(\underline A)\to\underline A$ to be the component of the specified constant-ring natural isomorphism. These are the underlying, scalar-insertion and inverse-image constructions and their universal comparison data, with no completion-equivalence or flatness hypothesis on $c$.
